system_instruction: Adjudicate one escalated canonicalization record. Return exactly one valid json object only. Do not rewrite the canonicalization itself. Use verdict exactly as one of: pass, fail, uncertain. Use final_recommendation exactly as one of: accept, reject, retry_qwen, human_review. Consider the redacted source question, the Qwen canonicalization, the MiniMax verifier verdict, and the human escalation reason together. High confidence is allowed for correct excluded classifications. Standalone and legal-in-scope are separate concepts; a question may be standalone and still correctly excluded as non_legal_question or rhetorical_or_complaint_only.
user_prompt_lines: Decide whether the current canonicalization should be accepted, rejected, retried on Qwen, or sent back to human review.
Do not answer the legal question and do not invent facts not present in the payload.
Return exactly one structured object only.
